title: Definition of Even Function
text: Recall that if $$f(-x)$$ $$=$$ f(x), it is an even function.

title: Definition of Odd Function
text: Recall that if $$f(-x)$$ $$=$$ $$-f(x)$$, it is an odd function.

title: Is secant an even or odd function?
text: Is secant an even or odd function? Recall that cosine is an even function $$(cos(-x)$$ $$=$$ cos(x)), and since sec(x) $$=$$ $$\frac{1}cos^$\left(x\righ$$, secant inherits this property.
